spec.definitions:
def a (n : Nat) : Nat := n * n

def ps : List Nat :=
  (List.range 200).filter (fun k => (List.range 15).any (fun n => a n == k))

def check : Bool :=
  match ps with
  | [] => false
  | _ => ps.zip ps.tail |>.all (fun p => p.2 - p.1 > 0) && (ps.head! = 0)
